reserve.name: Gaia proper motions / astrometry
reserve.what: Gaia kinematics as a GRAVITY dataset
reserve.contact: Gaia appears in 178 lane files, but as an ASTROMETRIC FRAME ('RA/Dec aligned to Gaia DR2'), not as a gravity dataset. EXCLUDED from the reserve: any Gaia-derived wide-binary quantity, which is separately sealed. RESERVED: proper motions and parallaxes used dynamically.

reserve.name: MUSE/Granata internal dispersions
reserve.what: 213 internal stellar velocity dispersions in HFF members
reserve.contact: MUSE appears in 98 lane files, but as SPECTROSCOPIC REDSHIFTS for cluster membership -- those are spent. RESERVED: only the internal velocity DISPERSIONS (Granata 2026), which were inventoried (213 counted) but never entered a gravity statistic.

scoping_rule: Scope a confirmation reserve by DATA PRODUCT, not by survey name. A survey can be simultaneously spent and pristine: MUSE redshifts are spent for membership while MUSE internal dispersions are untouched; Gaia is spent as an astrometric frame while its dynamical products are untouched. Naming the survey would have burned the pristine half or falsely cleared the spent half.

declared_statistic.primary: median |log10(g_obs_pred / g_obs_meas)| over the object's measured radial range, computed on RAW observables after the candidate law and the instrument forward model are both applied
declared_statistic.comparator: the same quantity for the RAR with a0 frozen at its galaxy-calibrated value and no free parameter
declared_statistic.decision: the candidate must beat the comparator on the reserve with every parameter frozen; a tie or a loss is a null result and is reported as such
forbidden: refitting any parameter on the reserve, global or per-object
choosing the radial range after seeing residuals
reporting a subset without the full-sample number beside it
a second evaluation of the same reserve for the same law family
declared_statistic.power_precondition: the responsiveness d(estimate)/d(injected) must be measured on synthetic data and reported BEFORE the reserve is opened; a null with unstated power is not a result

model_slot: EMPTY BY DESIGN -- no law is promoted. The statistic above is frozen first so it cannot later be chosen to fit.
